items.title: Earl King Interview, 1980-04-10
items.q: his songs have been recorded by artists such as ... Fats Domino

ctx.x: I thought that was a little bit better. I thought that was a little bit better. What was different from this? The other recordings seemed to have more bluesy. The sounds a little softer. Ah.

It seemed to have more country. That's what it is. You're saying it's got more of a little tinge of the country line. That guitar solo that went off. I think the piano solo came out. Everybody was playing that country thing. I've had a little bit of mine. With that. Actually, it was kind of yodeling on it. That's what I was thinking about. With that. With that. With that. With that. With that. With that. With that. With that. With that. That little yodel effect. Yeah. Put it on a 50-50 basis. Like the R&B in the…
Do you think this influenced other artists in the region? Oh.
